standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial group
standard_prerequisites.statement: A simplicial set in which every level carries a group structure and the face and degeneracy maps are group homomorphisms.
standard_prerequisites.use: The group structure supplies the inverses and products used to build the correction terms at every step of the induction (source lines 5974, 5985-6018).

standard_prerequisites.name: Horn and the Kan condition
standard_prerequisites.statement: The k-th horn of the n-simplex is obtained by deleting the k-th face, and a simplicial set is Kan when every morphism from a horn extends to the whole simplex.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof starts from a morphism of the horn and produces the extension x (source lines 5977-5983, 6018-6019).

standard_prerequisites.name: Face and degeneracy relations
standard_prerequisites.statement: The simplicial identities relating the face and degeneracy maps in the simplex category.
standard_prerequisites.use: The compatibility of the x_i and the verification of the constructed elements use the simplicial identities (source lines 5983-5984, 6010-6018).

core_obligations: Translate the horn into face data: from a morphism of the k-th horn of the n-simplex, set x_i to be the image of the i-th face and record the compatibility relations d_i x_j = d_{j-1} x_i for i, j different from k (source lines 5981-5984).

Run the filling induction: construct elements x^r for r = 0, ..., n-k, starting from the degenerate element attached to the known face and then, at each step, build x^{r+1} by multiplying with an inverse and a degeneracy so that the face relations d_i x^{r+1} match the prescribed x_i on the already covered range (source lines 5985-6018).
Conclude the extension: take x = x^{n-k} and observe that its faces are exactly the x_i, so the horn morphism extends and the simplicial group is Kan (source lines 6018-6019).

proof_roadmap.step: Read the horn morphism as elements x_i of the (n-1)-simplices with the compatibility relations.
Inductively build x^r, correcting faces with inverses and degeneracies until all prescribed faces are matched.
Take x = x^{n-k} as the required extension of the horn.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-simplicial-group-kan at source lines 5972-5975: every simplicial group is a Kan complex. The proof at source lines 5977-6020 is a long and genuinely constructive filling argument, and it is the classical one: given a horn in a simplicial group, write its faces as elements x_i of the (n-1)-simplices, note the compatibility relations they satisfy, and then fill the horn by an induction that produces elements x^r for r = 0, ..., n-k, each time manufacturing the next one out of the inverses and the degeneracies of the already produced faces so that the required face relations hold. The final element x = x^{n-k} has the prescribed faces. The induction has to be carried out with the correct indexing (the range of the index k determines how many steps are needed) and the verification at each step uses both the face and the degeneracy relations in a simplicial group, where the group structure is what supplies the inverses and allows the correction term. The statement records only the conclusion. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
